[P1] 童读·中华经典神话故事
姜子牙钓鱼
李永凤/改编 陈伟工作室/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P2] 中华经典神话故事绘本
姜子牙钓鱼
李永凤/改编  陈伟工作室/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P3] 渭水河边。
“呱——呱——”一只青蛙从一块石头蹦到另一块石头，冲水里喊道：
“小鲤鱼，快出来——”
“大嗓门，又有什么事？”小鲤鱼冒出小脑袋，有点儿恼火。
“上次说的那个怪老头儿，今天又来了，瞧！”青蛙说着朝岸上努了努嘴。

[P4] 小鲤鱼急忙往岸边游去，把老头儿
瞧个仔细：
白发，白胡，粗布白衣；
他面色平静，正缓缓举起鱼竿……

“哎哟，我可不上你的当！”看到鱼竿甩过来，小鲤鱼吓了一跳。
“哈哈，放心吧，他永远都不会把你钓上去的。”青蛙大笑着说。

[P5] “为什么？”小鲤鱼疑惑地问道。
青蛙还来不及回答，就听见岸上
传来一阵怒吼，“姜子牙，你又不做正
经事，跑到这里来干坐着干嘛？！”，

“种地赔种子，卖肉肉臭，卖面亏
本……我真是命苦啊……”一个老婆
婆冲到怪老头儿跟前，责骂不停。

[P6] “嫂子，这条鱼给你，快回去做饭吧。”
旁边一位钓者，见状赶紧从自己的鱼篓里
抓起一条鱼递给她。鱼儿活蹦乱跳，老婆婆
双手抓着鱼，又抱怨了几句，才转身回家。

“老哥，你这样是钓不到鱼的。
不介意的话，我来教教你？”钓鱼者同情地对姜子牙说。

[P7] 这时，一位路过的樵夫停下来说：“您的钓钩这么直，还不挂鱼饵，鱼竿举得离水面三尺高……老伯呀老伯，不是我说您，就这种钓法，别说一天，就是一百年也别想钓到一条鱼。”

[P8] “我的鱼钩不是为了钓鱼，而是要钓王与侯。”姜子牙慢悠悠地说道。
“鱼钩不钓鱼，倒想钓王侯？你这也太离奇了吧？”钓鱼者和樵夫哈哈大笑，都觉得这老头儿一定是疯了。
小鲤鱼仔细观察，发现樵夫说的一点儿没错。
“怪不得你不担心我被钓上去呢。”小鲤鱼放心地对青蛙说。
“怪老头儿，果然怪吧？”青蛙得意地笑了。

[P9] “听说我们的首领西伯侯姬昌今日出来打猎，我还是去瞧瞧热闹吧。”
樵夫看劝解不了姜子牙，匆匆走了。
“首领打猎，肯定有新鲜事发生，我给咱打探消息去。”好奇心强的青蛙，哪儿热闹往哪儿凑。
知道姜子牙对鱼没有威胁，小鲤鱼悠闲地在附近游荡起来。

[P10] 小鲤鱼正跟伙伴们在水草中捉迷藏，“咚咚咚咚……”岸上传来跑步声。小鲤鱼赶紧探出头来。

“喂，老头儿，西伯侯听说你钓鱼方式很奇怪，让我带你去见他。”一名士兵站在姜子牙身边说。
姜子牙并不理睬他，举着鱼竿，自言自语道：“钓啊，钓啊，鱼儿不上钩，虾儿来胡闹！”

[P11] 士兵看姜子牙没有跟他走的意思，恼怒地转身跑走了。
过一会儿，一个大官来了，他躬身请姜子牙：“西伯侯听闻您行事与众不同，特让我来请您去见面。”
小鲤鱼想，这个大官比士兵还有礼貌，姜子牙一定会答应的。可是姜子牙依然举着鱼竿，喃喃自语道：“钓啊，钓啊，大鱼不上钩，小鱼别胡闹！”

[P12] 大官无奈，只好离开了。
小鲤鱼刚要游走，青蛙一边蹦过来一边喊着：“西伯侯要来了，大鱼要来了！”
“是谁要来？是西伯侯还是大鱼？”
“嘿嘿，西伯侯就是大鱼，大鱼就是西伯侯。”

[P13] 小鲤鱼被青蛙的话绕晕了，瞪大眼睛往上瞧去。
岸上鼓乐齐鸣，一队人马
排列整齐地走了过来。中间车
辇上坐着的，正是西伯侯姬昌。

[P14] 在离姜子牙十几米远的地方，队伍停了下来。
西伯侯缓步走到姜子牙跟前，弯腰拱手道：“耽误您一点儿时间，不知您是否愿意与我聊一聊天下大事？”
这次，姜子牙终于放下了鱼竿。

[P15] “您一向待人宽厚，百姓们都拥护您。但我知道，您的心中还有更广阔的天地。商王帝辛如此残暴，在他的统治下，人们的生活都很悲惨。您忍心看着百姓在痛苦中挣扎吗？您曾被他无理拘禁，难道不想复仇吗？”姜子牙问西伯侯。西伯侯心中一震，赶紧坐下来与姜子牙细谈。

[P16] 两人聊了很久，刚开始西伯侯面色沉重，眉头紧皱，慢慢地越来越舒展，越来越激动，最后他情不自禁地拉住姜子牙的手说：“您目光远大、学识渊博，而且还懂兵法！我太公在世的时候，就一直盼望着有您这样的大贤之人来帮周族。我想请您做太师，帮我治理国家、推翻商王！”

[P17] “呱呱，呱呱，太公望太公望，姜子牙不再是怪老头，改叫姜太公啦！”青蛙呱呱叫着，“哗啦”一声跳进渭水，同小鲤鱼玩去了。
眼看着西伯侯拉着姜太公上了车辇，一旁的钓鱼者瞪大了眼睛，喃喃自语道：“姜太公钓鱼——愿者上钩。这下，我终于明白了。”
full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Reading · Classic Chinese Mythological Stories
Jiang Ziya Fishing
Adapted by Li Yongfeng, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P2] Chinese Classic Mythology Picture Book
Jiang Ziya Fishing
Adapted by Li Yongfeng, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P3] By the Wei River.
"Croak—croak—" A frog hopped from one stone to another and shouted into the water:
"Little carp, come out—"
"Loudmouth, what is it now?" The little carp poked its head out, a bit annoyed.
"That strange old man we talked about last time is here again, look!" The frog said, pointing toward the shore with its nose.

[P4] The little carp hurried toward the shore to take a good look at the old man:
White hair, white beard, rough white robe;
His face calm, he slowly raised his fishing rod……

"Oh no, I won't fall for your trick!" The little carp jumped in fright as the fishing rod swung over.
"Haha, don't worry, he will never catch you," the frog laughed.

[P5] "Why?" the little carp asked, puzzled.
Before the frog could answer, a furious shout came from the shore: "Jiang Ziya, you're not doing anything proper again! What are you doing, just sitting here?!",

"Planting fields loses seeds, selling meat stinks, selling flour loses money... I'm truly suffering..." An old woman rushed up to the strange old man and scolded him nonstop.

[P6] "Sister, here's a fish for you, go back and cook dinner quickly."
A nearby fisherman, seeing the situation, quickly grabbed a fish from his basket and handed it to her. The fish wriggled and jumped, the old woman grabbed it with both hands, complained a few more words, then turned and went home.

"Old brother, you're fishing like this, you won't catch any fish.
If you don't mind, I'll teach you?" The fisherman said sympathetically to Jiang Ziya.

[P7] At this moment, a passing woodcutter stopped and said, "Your fishing hook is so straight, and you haven't even baited it. You're holding the rod three feet above the water... Old man, old man, I'm not trying to offend you, but with this method, you won't catch a single fish in a day, let alone in a hundred years."

[P8] "My fishing hook is not for catching fish, but for catching kings and lords," said Jiang Ziya slowly.
"Fishing for kings and lords? That's too bizarre!" The fisherman and the woodcutter laughed heartily, thinking the old man must be mad.
Little carp carefully observed and found the woodcutter was absolutely right.
"No wonder you don't worry about me getting caught," the little carp said calmly to the frog.
"That strange old man, truly strange, isn't he?" the frog laughed proudly.

[P9] "I heard our leader, King Ji Chang of the Western Region, is out hunting today. I might as well go and see the commotion."
Seeing that he couldn't persuade Jiang Ziya, the woodcutter hurried away.
"The leader is hunting—there must be something exciting happening. I'll go scout the news for us." The curious frog, drawn to any commotion, headed straight for the excitement.
Knowing Jiang Ziya posed no threat to the fish, the little carp swam leisurely nearby.

[P10] The little carp was playing hide-and-seek with its friends among the waterweed. "Dong dong dong dong..." Running footsteps came from the shore. The little carp quickly poked its head out.

"Hey, old man, King Xi Bo has heard your fishing method is strange. Let me take you to meet him," said a soldier standing beside Jiang Ziya.
Jiang Ziya paid no attention, holding his fishing rod and muttering to himself, "Fishing, fishing, the fish won't bite, only shrimp come to cause trouble!"

[P11] The soldier saw that Jiang Ziya had no intention of following him, and angrily turned and ran away.
After a while, a high official arrived. He bowed to Jiang Ziya: "The Marquis of the West has heard of your unusual conduct and specially sent me to invite you to meet him."
The little carp thought, this official is more polite than the soldier; Jiang Ziya must surely agree. But Jiang Ziya still held his fishing rod, muttering to himself: "Fishing, fishing, big fish won't bite, little fish, don't make a fuss!"

[P12] The high official, helpless, could only leave.
As the little carp was about to swim away, the frog hopped over and shouted, “The Lord of the West is coming, the big fish is coming!”
“Who is coming? The Lord of the West or the big fish?”
“Hehe, the Lord of the West is the big fish, and the big fish is the Lord of the West.”

[P13] The little carp was confused by the frog's words and looked up with wide eyes.
On the shore, drums and music rang out as a procession of people and horses
marched forward in neat formation. Sitting in the central carriage
was none other than Lord Xi Bo, Ji Chang.

[P14] In a place about ten meters away from Jiang Ziya, the procession came to a halt.
Xibo Hou slowly walked up to Jiang Ziya, bowed respectfully, and said, "I apologize for taking up a little of your time. Would you be willing to chat with me about the affairs of the world?"
This time, Jiang Ziya finally put down his fishing rod.

[P15] "You have always been kind to others, and the people support you. But I know there is a broader world within your heart. King Di Xin of Shang is so cruel; under his rule, people's lives are miserable. Can you bear to see the people suffering? You were once unjustly imprisoned by him—don't you want revenge?" Jiang Ziya asked King Wen of the West. King Wen was deeply moved and quickly sat down to discuss matters with Jiang Ziya.

[P16] They talked for a long time. At first, King Wen looked solemn with furrowed brows, but gradually his expression became more relaxed and excited. Finally, he couldn't help but take Jiang Ziya's hand and said, "You have a far-sighted vision, profound knowledge, and even understand military strategy! When my grandfather was alive, he always longed for a great sage like you to help the Zhou clan. I wish to invite you to be my Grand Tutor, to help me govern the country and overthrow King Zhou!"

[P17] "Quack, quack, Taigong Wang, Taigong Wang, Jiang Ziya is no longer the strange old man, now called Jiang Taigong!" The frog croaked, then "splash" jumped into the Wei River to play with the little carp.
Watching the Lord of the West pull Jiang Taigong onto the carriage, the fisherman beside the river widened his eyes and murmured to himself: "Jiang Taigong fishing — those who wish to be caught will be caught. Now I finally understand."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《姜子牙钓鱼》的封面，展示了姜子牙在水边垂钓的场景，背景中有军队，上方标有书名、作者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《姜子牙钓鱼》的封面，展示了姜子牙在水边垂钓的场景，背景中有山石和水草，下方标注了出版社信息。
[P3] 在渭水河边，一只青蛙跳到石头上，呼唤水中的小鲤鱼，小鲤鱼冒出头来，对青蛙的喊叫感到恼火，青蛙则指着岸边，提到那个‘怪老头儿’又来了。
[P4] 小鲤鱼仔细观察岸边垂钓的怪老头，发现他白发白胡、穿着粗布白衣，神情平静地举起鱼竿。小鲤鱼吓得躲开，青蛙则大笑说老头永远不会钓到它。
[P5] 小鲤鱼疑惑地询问原因，岸上一位老婆婆突然冲到姜子牙面前，愤怒地责骂他不务正业，抱怨自己生活困苦。
[P6] 一位钓者见老婆婆抱怨，便将自己钓到的鱼送给她，让她回家做饭；随后，这位钓者同情地对姜子牙表示，他这样钓鱼是钓不到鱼的，并主动提出要教他钓鱼。
[P7] 一位路过的樵夫看到姜子牙用无饵且高举的钓竿钓鱼，便上前嘲笑他，认为这种钓法永远钓不到鱼。
[P8] 姜子牙解释自己钓鱼是为了钓王侯，引来钓鱼者和樵夫的嘲笑；水中的小鲤鱼因此放心，与青蛙讨论姜子牙的怪异行为。
[P9] 樵夫因劝不动姜子牙而离开，前往观看西伯侯姬昌打猎；青蛙也因好奇去打探消息；小鲤鱼因确认姜子牙无害，便在附近悠闲游动。
[P10] 小鲤鱼在水草中玩耍时，听到岸上跑步声，探头张望。一名士兵前来劝说姜子牙去见西伯侯，但姜子牙不理睬，继续自言自语地钓鱼，认为虾在捣乱。
[P11] 士兵劝说姜子牙未果后离开，随后一位大官前来恭敬邀请他去见西伯侯，但姜子牙仍专注于钓鱼，自言自语地念叨着‘大鱼不上钩，小鱼别胡闹’。
[P12] 大官离开后，青蛙兴奋地告诉小鲤鱼西伯侯要来了，并解释西伯侯就是姜子牙要钓的‘大鱼’，小鲤鱼对此感到好奇。
[P13] 小鲤鱼被青蛙的话吸引，抬头望向岸边，只见西伯侯姬昌的车队鼓乐齐鸣、排列整齐地驶来，姜子牙仍在岸边专注钓鱼。
[P14] 西伯侯姬昌的车队停下，他亲自上前向姜子牙拱手邀请，询问是否愿意共商天下大事，姜子牙终于放下鱼竿。
[P15] 姜子牙向西伯侯姬昌提出天下大义，指出商纣王的残暴与百姓的苦难，激发姬昌的复国之志，姬昌深受触动，遂与姜子牙坐下详谈。
[P16] 西伯侯姬昌与姜子牙深入交谈后深受触动，主动邀请姜子牙担任太师，共同治理国家、推翻商纣王。
[P17] 青蛙兴奋地宣布姜子牙被尊称为姜太公，跳入水中与小鲤鱼玩耍；岸边的钓鱼者目睹西伯侯接走姜子牙，终于领悟了‘姜太公钓鱼，愿者上钩’的含义。
[P18] 画面呈现姜子牙与西伯侯姬昌在云雾缭绕的背景下对坐，姜子牙手指天空，似乎在讲述天命或封神之事，背景中有‘封神’字样，暗示二人正商议天下大计，开启封神之路。
